context_separation: Fresh /root/concrete_design_review subagent; source/design review without parent conversation. No GUI/runtime assessment.

progression.reason: Control practice is separate from conceptual teaching. Growing-input demonstration precedes supported prediction; context follows, then a changed repair case combining both ideas. The transfer includes two generated pieces.
progression.counterexample: Latest-piece-only reasoning passes one-piece practice but fails the changed case. Final completion after an incorrect first choice must not become independent success.

concept_fidelity.reason: Questions now ask what supplied information supports, not unjustified exact-word predictions. Prepared continuations are explicitly illustrative; real models can reject irrelevant notes.
concept_fidelity.counterexample: For Mira plus a Tavi note, a real model may say Mira’s location is unknown. Source-consistency is assessed separately from relevance and no model wording is graded.

decision_necessity.reason: First decisions precede answer feedback. Context, source-consistency and full-history input are separate observations; predictions cannot alter authoritative output.
decision_necessity.counterexample: Wick note plus Copper is source-consistent but irrelevant. Choosing the longest option remains a superficial strategy; one correct choice cannot establish mastery.

attention_and_access.reason: Distinct interaction states now specify lead/socket, open demonstration, covered input socket with prediction trays and staged note comparisons. Portrait reflow, keyboard order and state preservation are concrete enough to prototype.
attention_and_access.counterexample: A decorative device behind a scrolling questionnaire fails. At 360px and enlarged text, request and generated pieces must remain usable while choosing and returning to the world.

research_application.reason: Portal passive-success and spatial-explanation findings map to pre-feedback decisions and visible device cause/effect; scope stays bounded and adaptation limits are explicit.
research_application.counterexample: Repeated advances opening a latch must not record conceptual success. World labels obscuring a device on phones fail even if they share an anchor.
